column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- csnobol4_suite: the programs of this package that are NOT IN THE SPITBOL DIALECT, out of the published denominator, one row per program: name<TAB>NOT_SPITBOL_DIALECT<TAB>the feature, its dialect, the oracle's own refusal and CSNOBOL4's verdict.

# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# BOTH halves must hold: a program sbl -bf refuses for any OTHER cause (a SPITBOL-documented feature the x64 fork lacks, a Macro SPITBOL 370 convention, a missing input, a UTF-8 BOM, lowercase source waiting for its case conversion, a program broken under CSNOBOL4 too) STAYS in the denominator, named in OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv beside this file as debt.

# SPITBOL's own test deck (spitbol_testpgms/test1..8.spt and the csnobol4_suite copies diag1/diag2) is SPITBOL dialect BY ORIGIN (Lon 2026-09-26: "Get ALL 8 working in SCRIP since they are SPITBOL programs.") whatever the x64 fork refuses.
# 2026-10-02 (coo, Lon in-chat to the coo: "use CSNOBOL4 to gen the ORD tests"): ord.sno LEFT this list for EXTENSIONS.tsv -- graded against a ref cut by csnobol4, in the denominator.

# EXCLUDED=33 of the shipped population; the suite row reads pass / (shipped - EXCLUDED) with EXCLUDED named. Measured 2026-09-26 against sbl -bf (the ONE oracle) and csnobol4 -b (the reference engine, never a grader); the probes are recorded in GOAL-CEO.md CEO-1286.

column3: 8-bit Latin-1 bytes in a string literal in the source -- a CSNOBOL4 feature SPITBOL does not support: sbl -bf 8bit2.sno(1,2) ERROR 230 illegal character; csnobol4 runs it (ORACLE_ACCEPTANCE.tsv 2026-09-26)

the backslash unary operator as negation (\INTEGER(I), lines 57 and 59); SPITBOL's negation is ~ only and \ is not an operator -- a CSNOBOL4 feature SPITBOL does not support: sbl -bf alis.sno(57,14) ERROR 230 illegal character; csnobol4 runs it (ORACLE_ACCEPTANCE.tsv 2026-09-26); probe pd: X = \INTEGER('a') 'yes' prints yes under csnobol4, ERROR 230 under sbl -bf

the four-argument INPUT(.var, unit, 'K10', 'file') association with a CSNOBOL4 record-length spec (line 5); SPITBOL's INPUT takes (.var, channel, 'filename[options]') -- a CSNOBOL4 feature SPITBOL does not support: sbl -bf No END statement found (case) and, folded, the association is refused; csnobol4 runs it (ORACLE_ACCEPTANCE.tsv 2026-09-26)
